config.protocol: Two paired arms, fixed versus supervised context Transformer; same initialization, lexical head, examples, order and epoch budget. Phase is frozen. No test-driven tuning. Fit marginal temperature on the next document fold per language. All ten held-out folds are evaluated once. Training is capped by whole document groups: a capacity-limited CV pilot, not a full-data or official CoNLL test score.

paired.scope: conditional document uncertainty; overlapping CV training sets and initialization uncertainty are not captured

limitations: Two paired arms, fixed versus supervised context Transformer; same initialization, lexical head, examples, order and epoch budget. Phase is frozen. No test-driven tuning. Fit marginal temperature on the next document fold per language. All ten held-out folds are evaluated once. Training is capped by whole document groups: a capacity-limited CV pilot, not a full-data or official CoNLL test score.
One training seed per fold; document intervals do not measure training-seed uncertainty.
Token boundary calibration is a marginal log-odds temperature transform; it does not retrain the CRF or alter full-text decoding.
Wait is measured in received characters with synthetic fixed-size feeds; CPU times are descriptive local measurements.
